nodes.description: Public array of GameInfo structs holding funder/winner mappings per game round.
Public counter of the current game round index; incremented when a round fills up.
Mapping(address => uint) tracking the last game index a user joined.
Mapping(address => uint) holding withdrawable ETH credited to winners and referrers.
Mapping(address => address) referral graph used to distribute multi-level commissions.
Address of the contract deployer/manager receiving fees and default referral.
Base prize unit (10000000000000000 / 5) used to size payments and entry value.
Constructor; sets manager = msg.sender, self-references referrer and pushes the first GameInfo.
Payable entry function: registers funder, updates referral, resolves winners and credits balances.
Withdraws the caller's funderBalance after a checked subtraction and an external transfer.
View helper returning the caller's last game, funder count, winner and balance.
View helper returning the current game number, funder count and winner.
Caller-controlled address used as player identity, balance key, referral key and payout recipient.
now; miner-influenced timestamp used to derive the random winner index.
msg.sender.transfer(amount) external ETH send performed inside withdraw.
funderBalance[msg.sender] += -amount unchecked-style uint arithmetic on withdrawable balance.
uint winNum = (now + gameNum) % 3; winner chosen from a timestamp-derived index (weak randomness).
Batch credits of 285*count / 3*count / count / count/2 to winner, manager and up to six referrer levels.
games[gameNum].funderNum += 1 and gameNum += 1 unbounded counter arithmetic.
Referrer address supplied by the caller of addIn and written into the referrer mapping.
Withdrawal amount supplied to withdraw, checked against and subtracted from funderBalance.
Local index computed from now and gameNum that selects the round winner.
Loop index (uint8) iterating over the three funders during reward distribution.
Local address loaded from referrer[funder[i]] used to walk the referral chain.

edges.reason: The constructor writes msg.sender into the manager state variable.
The constructor sets referrer[manager] = manager, seeding the referral graph.
msg.sender becomes the privileged manager with no access restriction.
msg.sender is used as the funder identity, lastGame key and referrer key in addIn.
msg.sender selects the balance checked and is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
lastGame is written and read using the caller-controlled msg.sender key.
funderBalance entries are keyed by the caller-controlled msg.sender address.
referrer mapping is indexed by msg.sender when a user joins for the first time.
The ETH transfer target is the attacker-controlled msg.sender address.
winNum is derived from block.timestamp (now), a miner-influenceable value.
The timestamp-derived winNum selects the winner inside the game resolution logic.
The referr parameter flows into addIn's first-join referral branch.
The attacker-supplied referr address is stored in the referrer mapping.
The amount parameter drives the require check and the withdrawal transfer.
amount is subtracted from funderBalance using += (-amount) uint arithmetic.
addIn executes the timestamp-based winner selection when funderNum reaches 3.
addIn executes the multi-level commission credit block on round completion.
addIn increments funderNum and gameNum without any cap or overflow guard.
addIn records the caller's referrer on first join.
addIn writes the current gameNum into lastGame[msg.sender].
addIn reads count to validate msg.value and to size all prize credits.
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer after updating state.
withdraw mutates funderBalance[msg.sender] with uint negation arithmetic.
The unsafe balance update writes the funderBalance state mapping.
The external transfer can hand control to the recipient, which may re-enter withdraw/contract logic.
Commission credits write into the funderBalance mapping for winner, manager and referrers.
On round completion gameNum is incremented and never bounded.
The timestamp-derived winNum determines which address receives the 285*count credit.
getLastGame reads lastGame[msg.sender] to locate the caller's game.
getLastGame reads funderBalance[msg.sender] to report the caller's balance.
getNewGame reads gameNum to report the current game index.
The timestamp-selected winner is written into funderBalance via the winner mapping.
addIn runs a fixed three-iteration loop over the funders using index i.
The loop index i selects funder[i] whose referrer is loaded into addr.
The walked referral addresses from addr drive successive funderBalance credits.

normalization_plan.reason: The referr parameter is only used inside addIn to populate the referrer mapping, so it should be collapsed into the addIn function node.
The amount parameter exists solely to drive the balance check, the uint subtraction and the transfer inside withdraw.
winNum is the intermediate local produced by the (now + gameNum) % 3 expression and should be folded into that unsafe timestamp operation.
The loop index i exists only to drive the reward distribution loop, so it merges into the fund credit unsafe operation.
addr is a temporary address fetched from the referral chain during reward distribution and belongs to the same unsafe credit operation.
